title: Trumpet players in Barnes's band: Shelley Lamelle, Diddy and Euless Jean
summary: Allen and Reason sort out which trumpeters played when, including who was in Homer.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Anyway, did you mention Shelley Lamelle? I know we talked about him. That's Shelley Lamelle was with us.
Yeah. And the band was with Paul Head with Niddy Luschen.
That was one of the trumpet players. Used to live downtown below Lone Avenue. Yeah.
Now, let's get this straight. Euless John was there, Shelley Lamelle and Diddy. That's right.
Were they all there at once, or did they have two, or how did that work? No.
No. No. Diddy and Shelley were the two trumpet players. Yeah. They were two trumpet players.
But when we were working in Homer, Louisiana, Diddy and Euless John. Oh, I see.

That's what you pronounce it. John. John. That's what. Creole, you know. Mm-hmm. They're not Creole. Yeah. We Creoles. They were playing, the two trumpet players playing in our band we had at home. Those two trumpet players.
